name: com.neoxider.durablequeue
description: Durable outbox for unreliable networks: records survive a restart, keep FIFO inside a stream, retry with exponential backoff and full jitter, and end up in a capped dead-letter instead of disappearing. Storage, transport, retry policy, codec, clock and log are ports, so the library knows nothing about a concrete HTTP API, engine storage or host domain. Ships two lanes over one policy: durable (fire-and-forget, survives restart) and immediate (the caller gets the answer or a visible error).
